name: People You May Know from contacts and calendar
plain: LinkedIn uses uploaded contacts and others' uploads to suggest connections.
meaning: A person's number or email in someone else's address book can feed suggestions about them even if they never uploaded anything.

limits.headline: Can suggest you to people from their uploaded contacts, even if you never uploaded yours
limits.user_action: Nothing from you. It happens when someone else uploads their address book
can: Match your number or email found in someone else's address book
Use uploaded contacts and calendar to build suggestions
cannot: Be stopped by denying contacts on your own phone
Be controlled through a phone permission prompt; it happens on the server

story.what_it_is: LinkedIn suggests people to connect with, using uploaded address books and what other people uploaded.
story.for_you: You see people you might know. Some are surprising, like a doctor or an ex. Your number or email can reach LinkedIn when someone else uploads their address book, even if you never joined.
story.for_makers: Contact uploads link people in ways no profile can. LinkedIn uses them to grow connections and keep members active. Mixing your contacts with others' makes strange guesses and can reveal who knows whom.

use_cases.example: LinkedIn shows a recruiter you met once because she has your number.
A dating app uses uploads to avoid showing people you know, the reverse of the same data.
A chat app suggests friends from address books uploaded by others.
A photo app suggests people to follow from shared contacts.
A security researcher shows how uploads can reveal a hidden link between two people.
A sales app suggests leads from the contacts a coworker uploaded.
A support group app hides a member's real links so they cannot be linked.

story.android_note: The Android LinkedIn app can ask to sync your contacts, and you can turn it off.
story.ios_note: The iPhone LinkedIn app asks for contacts and you can turn off sync in Settings.

technical_bounds: Imported contacts deleted immediately on request; suggestions can take up to 72 hours to update

linkedin.how: Policy 1.2 says LinkedIn receives contact info when others import or sync contacts, or scan business cards. Section 2.1 uses address book uploads for suggestions. LinkedIn help: contacts deleted immediately, suggestions update within 72 hours.

history.change: Contacts sync reported as no longer supported on LinkedIn help pages (date not stated)
